task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.82, 0.23, 0.84, 0.83, 0.75, 0.54, 0.95, 0.27] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
